operators.name: custom_equal
semantics: Computes torch.equal(x, y) on CUDA float32 tensors.
Returns a Python bool indicating whether the two tensors have the same size and all corresponding elements are exactly equal (bit-wise).
Inputs are on CUDA; comparison occurs on device and scalar result is transferred to CPU as Python bool.

operators.name: custom_l1_loss
semantics: Computes torch.nn.functional.l1_loss(x, y, reduction='mean') on CUDA float32 tensors.
Result is mean of absolute element-wise differences: sum(|x_i - y_i|) / numel.
Returns a zero-dimensional CUDA float32 tensor.
Checks whether x and y have identical shape and all corresponding elements are exactly equal.
Returns a Python bool (False for this task's random inputs).
Computes mean absolute error between x and y with default reduction='mean'.
Returns a zero-dimensional CUDA float32 tensor.
Returns the scalar tensor from step_002.
